name: Shader SVG
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only (a shader fill inside an SVG logo); no upstream source was fetched or read, and raw WebGL replaces the shader dependency so the port ships with zero imports. Meant for brand marks and wordmarks, not over product photography.

colorA.description: First palette colour (hex for the shader; any CSS colour for the fallback gradient).

colorC.description: Accent colour that blooms through the flow.

speed.description: Flow speed multiplier; 0 holds a still frame.

scale.description: Pattern zoom; larger values give tighter swirls.

angle.description: Main flow direction, in degrees (also the fallback gradient angle).

a11y: The logo SVG keeps its own role and label; the added clip path, canvas and fallback layer are aria-hidden and ignore the pointer.
The shader layer is clipped to the logo's own shapes, so its footprint and legibility are the same as the plain logo's.
Reduced motion draws one still frame and runs no animation loop; a live change of the preference stops or resumes the loop.
Forced-colors mode hides the shader layer so the logo paints in its system colours.
